- Baker’s cofinite-ideal definition of the finite dual conflicts with the point-free identification stated in §3.2 for the primitive polynomial Hopf algebra. A thesis independently identifies the point-indexed group-like functionals.[Baker’s notes](https://www.maths.gla.ac.uk/~ajb/SMSTC/HopfAlgebrasNotes.pdf) [Couto’s thesis](https://theses.gla.ac.uk/74418/1/2019CoutoPhD.pdf) The batch proof establishes its formula directly; the source convention still needs owner reconciliation.
